cases.purpose: Inject EINTR, an unmatched sequence, a zero ACK, a valid row and dump completion, requiring only the correctly decoded row.
cases.oracle: An independent probe decodes and checks each injected netlink packet and errno; actual fallback rows are identified by a locally owned listener and raw proc data.
cases.comparison: Check explicit semantic marker; retain exact notification requests/replies, injected message bytes, independent decoding, proc rows, child identity and raw output/status.
cases.setup_script:
[[ $UID == 2000 && $EUID == 2000 && $PWD == /tmp/parity-case && $HOME == /tmp/parity-home ]] || exit 125
IFS= read -r marker </etc/bashos-parity-vm || exit 125
IFS= read -r vendor </sys/class/dmi/id/sys_vendor || exit 125
[[ $vendor == QEMU && $marker =~ ^[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}$ ]] || exit 125
virt=$(/usr/bin/systemd-detect-virt --vm) || exit 125
[[ $virt == qemu || $virt == kvm ]] || exit 125
H=/opt/bashos-parity/harness/helpers/namespace-network-netlink-fault-r1.py
/usr/bin/python3 "$H" run retry control
